subject.title: [Feature]: Merge iOS Privacy and Location card state

question: Should the iOS Privacy cleanup replace the Off/While Using/Always segmented picker with Location Sharing and Background Location switches, or should the first fix only remove the duplicate Privacy summary card?
rationale: The duplicate card is clearly present, but the updated issue also changes the visible location-control model and should not be implemented automatically without maintainer UX intent.

options.title: Narrow duplicate-card cleanup
options.body: Remove the standalone Location-derived Privacy card first and keep the existing picker unless maintainers separately approve the switch redesign.

options.title: Approve the switch redesign
options.body: Allow the PR to replace the segmented picker with Location Sharing and Background Location controls if tests prove the same Off, While Using, and Always model behavior.

options.title: Wait for contributor PR
options.body: Keep the issue open without repair automation and review the reporter's claimed implementation when it arrives.

recommendation.title: Narrow duplicate-card cleanup
recommendation.body: Remove the standalone Location-derived Privacy card first and keep the existing picker unless maintainers separately approve the switch redesign.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest recent main-history signal on the iOS Settings and Location permission paths implicated here.
